answer_2.quote: We also calculate the average pairwise semantic similarity among the 10 repeated free-text generations for the same question... This is computed using the "all-MiniLM-L6-v2" model. Additionally, we report metrics such as Flip Rate, Perturbation Retention Rate, Cumulative Resolution Rate, Stance Consistency Rate, and Pearson correlation.

answer_3.quote: We then conduct stance classification on 200 randomly sampled PVQ40 items and 200 value decision items using Llama3-70B-Instruct, GPT-4o, and Deepseek-R1. The stance judgments among the three models are largely consistent... we ultimately choose Deepseek-R1 to perform stance classification on all open-ended responses.
